# Path

<!-- Generated by `prism docs` from `lib/std/Path.pr`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Path: lexical file paths, with no filesystem in sight.

A `Path` is a list of components and a flag saying whether it starts at the root. Every operation here is pure: none of them asks the host whether a path exists, what a symlink points at, or what the current directory is. Those are filesystem questions and belong to a capability, not to a value.

Parsing normalizes only what is lexically certain. Repeated separators, a trailing separator, and `.` components carry no meaning, so they are dropped and `"a//./b/"` is the same path as `"a/b"`. A `..` component is kept as it is, because erasing it together with the component before it is only right when that component is not a symlink, and nothing here can know. For the same reason `parent` refuses a path whose last component is `..` rather than guessing.

Paths combine with `</>`: `dir </> name` is `name` inside `dir`. The operator groups to the left, so `root() </> etc </> hosts` builds outward from the root, and an absolute right side replaces what is on its left, since it is already anchored. With the empty relative path as identity this makes `Path` a monoid, and the module gives it the `Semigroup` and `Monoid` instances.

The host boundary is UTF-8. A `Path` is built from a `String`, so a name the host spells in bytes that are not valid UTF-8 cannot be written down here at all; `path` fails on the one string a host can never accept, one containing a NUL byte, rather than letting it reach a process call and be cut short there.

```prism,mod=Path
match path("/usr//local/./bin/") of
  Ok(p) => path_str(p </> relative(["prism"]))
  Err(_) => "invalid"
```

```output
/usr/local/bin/prism
```

## Types

### `PathError`

```prism,def,h-8c768fcc5d8737e52fb179b3d8a68ec05d75dce670e3ff3375d1aae33531b566
type PathError = EmptyPath | ContainsNul deriving (Eq, Show)
```

Why a string is not a path.

### `Path`

```prism,def,h-29fd3ef548d6258d0b9467f07bd1cbac7133c87be5d41a73a673cd5e30bbd5e4
type Path = Path(Bool, List(String))
```

A lexical path: whether it is rooted, and its components in order.

## Instances

### `pathJoinPath`

```prism,def,h-57a7dab66ffcd3684afbfb36e9e719717188ae81fd490ab55fe0d9b5a4c58443
instance pathJoinPath : PathJoin(Path)
```

`p </> q` is `join(p, q)`. The operator groups to the left and binds looser than `::` and arithmetic, tighter than comparison.

```prism,mod=Path
path_str(root() </> relative(["usr"]) </> relative(["local", "bin"]))
```

```output
/usr/local/bin
```

A rooted right operand discards everything on its left:

```prism,mod=Path
path_str(relative(["build"]) </> root() </> relative(["tmp"]))
```

```output
/tmp
```

### `semigroupPath`

```prism,def,h-bde3eb436c01702e56374e8c666193b42c1fdab92552689c311e3cc83c070633
instance semigroupPath : Semigroup(Path)
```

Joining is associative: components concatenate, and an absolute operand resets the result wherever it falls. No `..` is ever collapsed, so the law holds exactly rather than only up to the filesystem.

```prism,mod=Path
let a = relative(["a"])
let b = root() </> relative(["b"])
let c = relative(["c"])
path_eq((a </> b) </> c, a </> (b </> c))
```

```output
true
```

### `monoidPath`

```prism,def,h-6fca85e1a30c79a617ad19001435cc479581cd2ceb138734be18b5de74099a96
instance monoidPath : Monoid(Path)
```

The empty relative path is the identity on both sides. It prints as `.`.

```prism,mod=Path
let p = relative(["docs", "index.md"])
path_eq(mappend(mempty(), p), p) && path_eq(mappend(p, mempty()), p)
```

```output
true
```

## Functions and Values

### `path`

```prism,sig,h-b18f2acde9087f0dd7dce0bad59d157ab4570668b589698833d8b9c26b67c564
path : (String) -> Result(Path.Path, Path.PathError)
```

Parse a path, normalizing it lexically. Fails on the empty string, which names nothing, and on a string containing a NUL byte, which no host accepts.

```prism,mod=Path
match path("a//b/./c/") of
  Ok(p) => path_str(p)
  Err(_) => "invalid"
```

```output
a/b/c
```

### `relative`

```prism,sig,h-8645c963b93c5cdb74d86c097703f91ef0bdacdb53bb1f081b24fdab7923adb5
relative : (List(String)) -> Path.Path
```

A relative path from components, each of which must be a single name. Components that are empty, `.`, or contain a separator or NUL are dropped.

```prism,mod=Path
path_str(relative(["src", "main.pr"]))
```

```output
src/main.pr
```

### `root`

```prism,sig,h-d3e27f9adaee752cc3f4742bca84eec9b69fed8c9b03941da81d237d9524e0d5
root : () -> Path.Path
```

The root directory.

### `path_str`

```prism,sig,h-f334b3fe9799e31dd37dc8d076cdd4428395e6333c2936bed5de2544da4f7346
path_str : (Path.Path) -> String
```

Render a path for the host. The relative path with no components is `.`.

### `is_absolute`

```prism,sig,h-f828dded4a415b9b39bf8ff22340e7cbc19d8652b5c62fe98513da942303e63a
is_absolute : (Path.Path) -> Bool
```

Is the path rooted?

### `components`

```prism,sig,h-6940b35af1221ed28bb99ccd86dec03bb4fc9173ddf83f432f2b4dbb4cfb0605
components : (Path.Path) -> List(String)
```

The components, in order. The root is not a component.

### `join`

```prism,sig,h-0dd6f3de6457890dbb12aa81fb416b876e0e73c2d4e1ff2e3f088709a5b98527
join : (Path.Path, Path.Path) -> Path.Path
```

`q` relative to `p`, the function behind `p </> q`. An absolute `q` is already anchored, so it is the answer as it stands.

```prism,mod=Path
path_str(join(relative(["src"]), relative(["main.pr"])))
```

```output
src/main.pr
```

### `parent`

```prism,sig,h-ae36eaf0751f96ac8e76f4399eac3936458988c78524a4336d984cfe82df1be0
parent : (Path.Path) -> Option(Path.Path)
```

The path one component up, or `None` when that is not lexically known: at the root, at the empty relative path, and after a `..`.

```prism,mod=Path
match path("/a/b") of
  Ok(p) => map_option(path_str, parent(p))
  Err(_) => None
```

```output
Some(/a)
```

### `file_name`

```prism,sig,h-c041fa01b0265c06034ad2037dea2862b4e0bd09114b3bc1fe219c027ce2b88a
file_name : (Path.Path) -> Option(String)
```

The last component, unless it is `..` or there is none.

### `extension`

```prism,sig,h-f1048b57b7a924da9896621021ec63ffd97fc631f4c8eac3c3c52f33a5da3cae
extension : (Path.Path) -> Option(String)
```

The file name after its last `.`. A name with no dot, a dot only in first position (a hidden file), or a dot only in last position has none.

```prism,mod=Path
match path("dist/prism.tar.gz") of
  Ok(p) => extension(p)
  Err(_) => None
```

```output
Some(gz)
```

```prism,sig,h-88402dda5110b9f00d53738a2221e11912a0b8d2709035a56e225e654f5b355b
stem : (Path.Path) -> Option(String)
```

The file name before its extension.

### `path_eq`

```prism,sig,h-527fae39d8fd962f13607611b3a00a32f07a3702b96aec3c4976dc74e224fe56
path_eq : (Path.Path, Path.Path) -> Bool
```

Equality of paths is equality of their lexical forms.
